contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FAVSTINA AVGUSTA ; R/ AVGVSTI PII FIL

Silver coin. Denarius of Faustina (II (147-175), as kindly identified by the finder; Mint of Rome, RIC vol. 3 no. 496, probably issue of 145-161. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with bun and draped right, long neck. Obverse inscription: FAVSTINA AVGUSTA. Reverse description: Draped figure [Concordia] standing left with cradled cornucopiae and right hand extended. Reverse inscription: AVGVSTI PII FIL. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 2.99gms, die axis: 6
